thread:
nora: RFC follow-up: thinking of shifting the canonical short-circuit fallback into the proxy runtime. locals evaluate a tiny policy and can flip routes in <100ms. central remains for overrides and global emergencies.

ishan: local is faster, but we must avoid host-level divergence. propose: policy_version + last_seen_epoch baked into decisions so central can reconcile.

claire: need flip damping. proposal: require degrade condition hold for A seconds, recovery require B seconds (B>>A) + flip_cooldown token. also sample 1% of decisions for full traces.

infra-bot: note: created alert template 'fast-local-flip' and added runbook item 'reconstruct-decision' to oncall.

nora: good. I'll draft minimal RFC with state machine, guidance message (epoch, ttl, sig), decision event schema, and canary plan (deploy binary to 2 clusters). tagging ishan/claire.
